summary: Applied 6 blocking spec-review repairs covering manifest contract, config bootstrap, workflow migration selection, registry-backed local preset overlays, local path reproducibility, and DataSource meta priority.

items.title: Plugin manifest contract is not defined
items.rationale: Added minimal plugin.json contract fields and contribution shapes for commands, presets, skills, config, and DataSource static meta.
items.evidence: spec.json constraints now define required plugin.json fields and per-contribution path/key fields.

items.title: Plugin-owned config validation has no bootstrap path
items.rationale: Added explicit config bootstrap order before plugin-owned section validation.
items.evidence: spec.json constraints and T-1 implementation_notes now define core plugin-state validation, manifest/schema loading, schema/default merge, and final validation.

items.title: Workflow migration cannot identify prior direct users
items.rationale: Defined migration selection as enabling official workflow plugin for every valid existing project unless another workflow provider is already enabled.
items.evidence: spec.json constraints, acceptance criteria, clarifications, and T-6 now cover broad existing-project workflow plugin migration.

items.title: Project-local preset overrides do not preserve plugin preset inheritance
items.rationale: Specified registry-backed project-local overlay behavior and parent-chain lookup through core base plus enabled plugin presets.
items.evidence: spec.json constraints, R5, acceptance criteria, and T-4 now define project-local overlay inheritance.

items.title: Local path sources conflict with commit-pinned reproducibility
items.target: Repo source and commit pinning semantics
items.rationale: Defined local path sources as clean Git repositories/worktrees with resolvable HEAD commits and rejection for non-Git/dirty paths.
items.evidence: spec.json constraints, R2, acceptance criteria, clarification, and T-2 now define local path reproducibility semantics.

items.title: DataSource static meta is both required and nice-to-have
items.rationale: Changed R6 priority to must to match user-selected initial scope and existing acceptance criteria.
